Meta.Author: Flemming Busman
Meta.Source: HeadRush Prime User Guide v4.0.0, section 4.22 "External MIDI Control"
Meta.Description: Set the global MIDI channel (Global Settings > MIDI; Omni available) to the channel configured in RigPilot's Device Settings, and enable Prog Change > Receive there for preset switching. "Select Rig" sends the program number set in each rig's "MIDI Prog" field (0-127). VERIFY ON HARDWARE: the user guide does not document the CC value semantics; block/looper toggles are modeled as state-dependent One-Shots.

OneShot.name: Select Rig
OneShot.description: Loads the rig whose 'MIDI Prog' field matches this program number.
